android.statement: Not tested on any physical Android version - not device-tested.

abi.statement: Pure Kotlin/Compose; no native code; all ABIs run the same bytecode.

pageSize16kb.statement: No native libraries, so 16 KB page size is not applicable; stated for completeness.

buildPairing.statement: Lab and Space must be signed with the same key in any installed pair; mixed pairs fail the signature check by design.
